pricing.faq.countA: Pro and Legendary are priced per user per month. Free has no charge and no member limit.
pricing.faq.dataA: Your boards and tasks stay. Plan changes and over-limit rules will be defined before billing goes live.
pricing.faq.dataQ: What happens to my data if I change plans?
pricing.faq.statusA: In the app: built and usable now. Preview: a demo, simulated, or kept only in your browser session. Planned: not built yet, or a limit the server doesn't enforce yet.
